subject: [PATCH bpf-next v2] bpf, cgroup: fix cgroup struct_ops query for a second attach type

reviews.author: patchwork-bot+netdevbpf@kernel.org
reviews.summary: The patch was automatically applied to the bpf/bpf-next.git repository by Alexei Starovoitov, with a thank you message from the bot.

2026-10-01.patch_summary: This patch fixes two issues in the cgroup struct_ops query code. Firstly, it removes a check that was only necessary because there was only one attach type (CGROUP_TCP_SOCK_OPS). With multiple types, this check would cause an 'impossible constraint' error during compilation. Secondly, it skips slots with type_id 0, which are not attached to any subsystem and should return -ENOENT instead of success.
